{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Count total number of enrolled patients
total_patients = len(trial_df)

# Count number of patients with severe baseline disease
severe_patients = trial_df[trial_df['severity'] == 'severe'].shape[0]

# Calculate the fraction
fraction_severe = severe_patients / total_patients

# Output the result
fraction_severe"}
